items.title: Implement fix for reproduced failure
items.userSees: `lattice done_closure` and `lattice review_escalation_status` for a DONE story report historical DONE closure instead of blocking on later main material drift; TEST-phase stories still show stale/missing evidence blockers before DONE.

happy.desc: A DONE story with valid historical completion evidence remains historically closed after unrelated current material drift; done_closure does not show blocking stale delivery/review escalation rows by default.
review_escalation_status for the same DONE story uses the historical completion snapshot by default and reports satisfied local review assurance instead of stale current-material verdicts.

edge.desc: A TEST-phase story still fails stale/missing delivery or review escalation evidence before DONE; the fix does not weaken pre-DONE gates.
Current-material revalidation information is explicit/advisory for DONE stories and does not overwrite historical closure semantics.

adversarial.desc: A tampered or story-owned drift case must not be silently accepted as historical closure for an unfinished story.
